display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
cv.yaml and job.txt
roles with bullet ids and skills with a start year,
and the posting as plain text

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
requirements · writer
position, company and the requirements,
each a must-have or a nice-to-have

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
quote guard · code
each requirement quotes the posting word for word,
else the writer is sent back

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
match · writer, one call per requirement
which CV bullets and skills show it,
empty when the CV shows nothing

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
id guard · code
bullet ids and skill names must exist in the CV

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gaps · agent, only for requirements nothing matched
the model decides: search the CV with other words,
read a bullet, ask you a question, report covered or gap

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tools · code
search_cv, read_cv_item,
ask_candidate (asks you in the terminal), report_finding

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
finding guard · code
covered needs CV bullets that exist or your own answer,
stored word for word; a requirement never reported stays a gap

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tailor · writer, one call per role
picks up to 4 bullets, orders them for the job,
rewords them in the posting's terms

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
reword guard · code
no number, identifier or tool name
that the source bullet does not have

div.style: color: rgb(34, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
letter · writer
up to 4 highlights, must-haves first, one sentence each
years of experience come from the CV, not the model
everything else is a fixed template

gap_report.pdf, for you only
not covered (do not claim), covered and by what,
what you told the agent
